# Revved for Growth

> Revved for Growth is an embedded revenue engine transformation practice for founder-led or family-owned B2B firms ($2M-$15M, sweet spot $5M-$10M) stuck in stalled, inconsistent growth. We are not advisory, not an agency, and not a fractional leadership placement. We operate inside the business and take ownership of how revenue is produced.

Tagline: **Revved for Growth.** · **From Stalled to Scalable Revenue.**

Core positioning: most options sit at the strategy, marketing, or advisory layer. We sit at the revenue system layer with end-to-end operational ownership across marketing, sales, and customer success.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/index.html): Hero, insights teaser, ICP, three ways to work together, proof, differentiation, CTA.
- [Insights](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights.html): Featured Series (2025 Founder-Led Report, 7 parts) and Notes from the Field (7 standalone pieces). All posts are hosted on fixyourrevenueengine.com.
- [Glossary](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/glossary.html): Plain-language definitions for the 20 terms founder-led or family-owned B2B operators actually use (fractional CRO, revenue engine, RevOps, CAC payback, NRR, Founder's Syndrome, etc.). DefinedTermSet JSON-LD schema for AI assistant citation.
- [Fractional CRO vs Marketing Agency](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/revenue-engine-rebuild-vs-marketing-agency.html): Comparison page. When each one fixes stalled revenue, when each one fails, three questions to decide which one you need.
- [Fractional CRO vs Full-Time CRO](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/fractional-cro-vs-full-time-cro.html): Comparison page. When the $400K hire is right, when the fractional path produces better outcomes, and the hybrid sequence most founders don't know to ask about.
- [Fractional CRO vs VP Sales Hire](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/fractional-cro-vs-vp-sales.html): Comparison page. Why the default VP Sales hire often fails to fix stalled revenue, when sales-execution leadership is actually what you need, and the sequence that produces a successful VP Sales onboarding.
- [About](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/about.html): Jason Rigolli, two-time co-founder and CRO with 24+ years rebuilding revenue engines. Past roles include CRO, VP Sales, VP Operations. Co-founded, scaled, and exited two businesses early in career (since 2002). Brand experience: Nestlé, Walmart, Spin Master, Virgin Mobile, Robbins Research International, CSS Group. Embeds Cal.com booking calendar.
- [Contact](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/contact.html): Embedded Cal.com booking calendar.

## Insights, published posts

### Featured series: The 2025 Founder-Led Report (7 parts)

- [Part 1: Why 2025 Demands a New Chapter](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/founder-led-report-part-1.html): The market founder-led businesses were built for has changed. 2025 demands a new chapter built on systems, not heroics.
- [Part 2: The Founder's Dilemma](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/founder-led-report-part-2.html): Founder's Syndrome is the moment when the same traits that built the business start to throttle it. Recognizing the transition is the first step.
- [Part 3: Strategic Planning for Founder-Led Businesses](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/founder-led-report-part-3.html): Strategic planning in a founder-led business is a quarterly system for choosing what to do, what to stop, and what to measure.
- [Part 4: Agile Growth Strategies](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/founder-led-report-part-4.html): Agile growth means short feedback loops, willingness to kill what isn't working, and a small set of bets you can actually run.
- [Part 5: Succession Planning for Founders](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/founder-led-report-part-5.html): Succession is a multi-year build, not a transaction. Start three to five years out.
- [Part 6: Role Clarity Boosts Business Growth](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/founder-led-report-part-6.html): When family or founder-led businesses don't have clean role definitions, growth stalls and trust erodes. The fix is structural.
- [Part 7: Future-Proof and Build Enduring Success](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/founder-led-report-part-7.html): Future-proofing isn't about predicting the market. It's about building systems that absorb shocks.

### Notes from the field (7 posts)

- [More fuel in a broken engine](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/more-fuel-broken-engine.html) (May 28, 2026), original thought-leadership: When pipeline stalls, most founders default to more spend or more headcount. Both make the problem worse if the engine itself is broken. Adding fuel to a broken engine just buys more expensive stagnation.
- [Insights for Founder-Led Businesses on the Road to Exit Success](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/founder-led-exit-success.html): An exit isn't an event you plan a year out, it's a system you build for years before.
- [Is SaaS Dead? How Fractional CROs Are Redefining the Future](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/is-saas-dead.html): SaaS isn't dead. The lazy version of SaaS is dead.
- [RevOps Metrics That Matter](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/revops-metrics-that-matter.html): Most revenue dashboards measure activity, not health. Six metrics that actually predict whether the engine is working.
- [From Conflict to Collaboration: Aligning Revenue Teams](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/revenue-team-alignment.html): Real alignment is structural, not cultural. Shared revenue targets, one definition of a qualified lead, documented hand-off SLAs.
- [Preserving Legacy, Building Future: Smooth Succession](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/preserving-legacy-succession.html): Most family-owned and founder-led businesses fail succession because of undocumented operations, not family dynamics.
- [Never Promote Top Performers](https://fixyourrevenueengine.com/insights/never-promote-top-performers.html): Promoting your best salesperson to manager usually breaks two things at once. Selling and managing are different jobs.

## Who this is for

Founder-led or family-owned B2B firms in the $2M-$15M revenue range (sweet spot $5M-$10M) experiencing one or more of: stalled or unpredictable growth, marketing-sales misalignment, founder-as-bottleneck dynamics, an upcoming exit or succession, or a planned scaling chapter that needs a working revenue system to support it.

## Who this is not for

Pre-revenue startups, venture-backed companies seeking blitzscaling support, single-function executive search, or businesses looking for advisory-only engagement without operational accountability.
